pages.text: CC: Tweaked adds computers and turtles you can program with real code (Lua).$(br2)Craft a $(bold)Turtle$() to get a little robot that can move, mine, and build for you.
Place it down and right-click to open it. Type $(bold)edit startup$() to write your first program, then $(bold)startup$() to run it.
Simple commands to try: $(bold)turtle.forward()$(), $(bold)turtle.dig()$(), $(bold)turtle.turnLeft()$() - line a few up and watch your turtle move!
